title.zh: 将北三宝颜省Liloy市镇Liloy医疗社区医院床位由10张增至25张并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Liloy Medicare Community Hospital in the Municipality of Liloy, Province of Zamboanga Del Norte, From Ten (10) to Twenty-five (25) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Liloy Medicare Community Hospital in the Municipality of Liloy, Province of Zamboanga Del Norte, From Ten (10) to Twenty-five (25) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tăng số giường bệnh của Liloy Medicare Community Hospital tại Thị trấn Liloy, Tỉnh Zamboanga Del Norte từ mười lên hai mươi lăm giường
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเพิ่มจำนวนเตียงของ Liloy Medicare Community Hospital ในเทศบาล Liloy, จังหวัด Zamboanga Del Norte จากสิบเป็นยี่สิบห้าเตียง
title.id: Undang-Undang menambah kapasitas tempat tidur dari Liloy Medicare Community Hospital di Kotamadya Liloy, Provinsi Zamboanga Del Norte dari sepuluh menjadi dua puluh lima tempat tidur
title.ms: Akta menambah kapasiti katil daripada Liloy Medicare Community Hospital di Perbandaran Liloy, Wilayah Zamboanga Del Norte daripada sepuluh kepada dua puluh lima katil

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7273_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The bed capacity of the Liloy Medicare Community Hospital in the Municipality of Liloy, Province of Zamboanga del Norte, is hereby increased from ten (10) to twenty-five (25) beds.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
